episode_title: 第二集：转世重生（原著第二章高还原精修版）
novel_chapter_ref: chapter_003_第二章_转世重生.md (+ chapter_004 现代客机失事闪回序幕)

canonical_anchor.source_quote: 将最后一条短信‘我爱你，永别了’发送出去后
canonical_anchor.must_preserve_detail: 现代男主独自在剧烈颠簸的客机座位上掏出手机按出『我爱你，永别了』，广播声来自机舱头顶喇叭而非空姐拿电话站在座位旁。

shots.visual_must_show: 单人近景：仅有现代男主一人系着安全带坐在剧烈摇晃的靠窗客机座椅上，头顶黄色氧气面罩垂落、窗外暴雨闪电，他紧咬牙关闭着嘴在手机上按下诀别短信，画面中绝无空姐拿电话站立。
shots.scene_summary: A 10-second 3D Chinese animation CG prologue inside a violently shaking modern commercial airliner during a catastrophic storm at night. Only <Subject 1> (28-year-old modern man) sits strapped in his window seat with oxygen masks dangling overhead, typing his final farewell on his smartphone while the overhead cabin PA speaker broadcasts an emergency warning.
shots.camera_motion: intense handheld-style camera shake with red emergency cabin lighting and lightning flashes through the window

dialogue_1.action: grips the shaking armrest and his glowing smartphone with his lips tightly closed as the cabin lurches violently
dialogue_1.line: 飞机遭遇强气流！请立即系好安全带！

dialogue_2.action: presses send on his phone screen with trembling thumbs and closes his eyes as the plane plunges into the dark ocean
dialogue_2.line: 躲不过去了吗……爸、妈，永别了！

shots.soundscape: Violent aircraft cabin turbulence rumble, overhead PA speaker static chime, thunderclap, and rushing ocean wind.

canonical_anchor.source_quote: 而这次楚铮醒来后谁也不理，总是一个人发呆
canonical_anchor.must_preserve_detail: 男主醒来后连续数日沉默不语，怔怔抬起六岁稚嫩小手，内心以成年人思维震惊剖析处境，并抗拒向陌生女人喊娘。

shots.visual_must_show: 单人特写：6岁楚铮额头缠着白纱布坐在古风雕花木床上，全程嘴巴紧闭一言不发，缓缓抬起稚嫩小手凝视，眼神呈现成年人的深沉震惊与迷茫。
shots.scene_summary: A 10-second 3D Chinese animation CG close-medium shot inside the Chu Mansion bedchamber. 6-year-old Chu Zheng (<Subject 1>) sits on the carved bed with a white forehead bandage, keeping his mouth completely closed in silence as he stares at his tiny hands, while his 28-year-old adult soul inner monologue (<Audio 1>) echoes.
shots.camera_motion: slow, contemplative push-in toward <Subject 1>'s tiny hands and shocked, mature eyes

dialogue_1.action: stares blankly at his tiny 6-year-old palms and fingers with his mouth strictly closed and brows furrowed in adult shock
dialogue_1.line: 我不是坠海死了吗？怎么变成六岁孩童了？

dialogue_2.action: lowers his tiny hands slowly with his lips still tightly closed, looking guardedly around the ancient bedchamber
dialogue_2.line: 北赵楚家……让我管陌生女人叫娘，我叫不出口。

shots.soundscape: Quiet ancient bedchamber ambience, subtle rustle of silk bedding, and ethereal inner-thought resonance.

canonical_anchor.source_quote: 小五是我儿子，就算他以后变成疯子、傻子，他也始终是我儿子
canonical_anchor.must_preserve_detail: 王秀荷为救儿子在地上磕头至额头鲜血淋漓，哭诉就算小五变成疯子傻子也照料他一辈子，额头鲜血滴在楚铮脸上，楚铮流泪在心中认下娘亲。

shots.visual_must_show: 母子近景：王秀荷额头有磕破的鲜血伤痕，含泪紧抱楚铮哭诉；楚铮眼角滑落热泪，前段闭嘴倾听内心破防，最后轻轻张嘴唤娘。
shots.scene_summary: A deeply emotional 10-second 3D Chinese animation CG close two-shot in the candlelit bedchamber. Mother Wang Xiuhe (<Subject 1>), with a bleeding bruise on her forehead from kowtowing, hugs 6-year-old Chu Zheng (<Subject 2>) tightly while weeping; moved by her maternal sacrifice, Chu Zheng sheds warm tears and finally accepts her as his mother.
shots.camera_motion: intimate emotional close-up with warm flickering candlelight

dialogue_1.action: hugs <Subject 2> tightly with fresh blood on her forehead and tears streaming down her cheeks
dialogue_1.line: 小五儿别怕，就算你傻了，娘也养你一辈子！

dialogue_2.action: closes his eyes as warm tears roll down his cheeks, then gently touches his mother's face and softly calls out
dialogue_2.line: 得母如此，夫复何求……娘，小五儿在这儿。

shots.soundscape: Soft weeping, crackling candle flame, and warm emotional xiao flute.

canonical_anchor.source_quote: 从怀中取出仅有的两枚铜钱，用食指抵住竖在桌上，微一运气，铜钱便无声无息地没入桌面
canonical_anchor.must_preserve_detail: 魔门血影宗主吴安然重伤逃亡至平原郡回味豆花店，身无分文之际听闻楚府门房张得利谈及五少爷醒后不语，遂用手指将两枚铜板按入木桌毛遂自荐。

shots.visual_must_show: 回味豆花店双人中景：吴安然坐在粗木桌旁，右手食指中指将两枚铜钱硬生生按入木桌表面，楚府门房张得利站在一旁震惊低头看嵌入木桌的铜钱。
shots.scene_summary: A 10-second 3D Chinese animation CG medium two-shot inside Huiwei Tofu Shop in Pingyuan City. Chu Mansion gatekeeper Zhang Deli (<Subject 1>) talks anxiously about the mute 5th young master, while fugitive Blood Shadow Sect Master Wu Anran (<Subject 2>) effortlessly presses two copper coins deep into the solid wooden tabletop with two fingers to volunteer himself.
shots.camera_motion: dynamic medium tracking shot tilting slightly from the embedded copper coins in the table up to Wu Anran's enigmatic smirk

dialogue_1.action: sighs anxiously beside the wooden table while gesturing toward the street
dialogue_1.line: 我家五少爷醒后不说话，老爷正重金求医呢！

dialogue_2.action: presses two bronze coins flush into the solid wood tabletop with two fingers and smirks coldly
dialogue_2.line: 善杀人者，必善医。带路吧，这诊金我接了！

shots.soundscape: Bustling ancient street eatery ambience, crisp wood-cracking sound as copper coins sink into the table.

canonical_anchor.source_quote: 小子，算你命不好，遇上我了
canonical_anchor.must_preserve_detail: 吴安然根本不是大夫，他在楚府偏厅屏退众人关紧房门，点住楚铮穴道后狞笑『小子，算你命不好，遇上我了』，以十成魔门大搜魂手拍向楚铮头顶。

shots.visual_must_show: 楚府偏厅双人近景（房门紧闭无旁人）：吴安然露出魔门宗主狞笑，右掌泛起黑红色魔门真气狠狠按在楚铮头顶百会穴；楚铮被点穴动弹不得，闭嘴瞪大眼睛惊骇。
shots.scene_summary: A tense 10-second 3D Chinese animation CG medium shot inside the closed Chu Mansion side hall with no bystanders. Having dismissed everyone and sealed the boy's acupoints, Blood Shadow Sect Master Wu Anran (<Subject 1>) drops his disguise with a sinister sneer and presses his dark-crimson Great Soul-Searching Hand onto 6-year-old Chu Zheng's crown, while Chu Zheng's adult soul (<Audio 2>) gasps internally.
shots.camera_motion: dramatic low-angle push-in as dark-crimson qi surges from <Subject 1>'s palm into the boy's crown

dialogue_1.action: sneers ruthlessly and presses his right palm glowing with dark-crimson demonic qi onto the boy's head
dialogue_1.line: 小子，算你命不好！受我十成大搜魂手！

dialogue_2.action: sits immobilized with his lips closed and eyes wide with alarm as a torrent of scorching qi pours into his head
dialogue_2.line: 不好！这恶贼根本不是郎中！

shots.soundscape: Ominous low demonic qi hum, sharp acupoint-sealing wind sound, and tense heartbeat.

canonical_anchor.source_quote: 原来世上真有天生任督二脉相通之人
canonical_anchor.must_preserve_detail: 十成大搜魂手真气入体竟毫无阻滞，楚铮毫发无损，吴安然满头冷汗骇然发现这六岁孩童竟是天生任督二脉相通的旷世奇才，动了收徒之念。

shots.visual_must_show: 反转中景：6岁楚铮端坐椅上毫发无损、周身泛起淡淡金青色经脉流光；吴安然震退半步满头冷汗，抬手看着楚铮满脸狂喜与震惊。
shots.scene_summary: A climactic 10-second 3D Chinese animation CG medium two-shot in the Chu Mansion side hall. Instead of harming the boy, the 100% Great Soul-Searching Hand qi circulates effortlessly through 6-year-old Chu Zheng's body in a golden-cyan meridian glow; Wu Anran (<Subject 1>) recoils in cold sweat and ecstatic shock upon discovering the boy's naturally connected Ren and Du meridians.
shots.camera_motion: dynamic reveal shot pulling back slightly as golden-cyan meridian light fades and <Subject 1> stumbles back in awe

dialogue_1.action: recoils half a step with cold sweat on his brow, staring at his own palm and the unharmed boy in utter disbelief
dialogue_1.line: 十成真气竟毫无阻滞？！天生任督二脉相通！

dialogue_2.action: blinks his bright dark eyes with his lips closed, feeling a warm refreshing current circulating smoothly through his chest
dialogue_2.line: 咦？那股霸道真气入体，我竟一点事都没有？

shots.soundscape: Resonant meridian chime, deep martial energy whoosh, and triumphant orchestral swell.
